title: Hainanese Chicken Rice
description: Poached chicken served with fragrant chicken rice and chili sauce.
ingredients: whole chicken, ginger, garlic, pandan leaves, jasmine rice, chicken stock, cucumber, light soy sauce, sesame oil, chili, lime
steps: Rinse the chicken and rub it with salt, then rinse again to clean the skin. | Bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer with ginger and spring onion, then poach the chicken until cooked and tender. | Shock the chicken in ice water to keep the meat juicy and the skin firm, then pat dry and rub with a little sesame oil. | Fry minced garlic and ginger in oil, add rinsed rice and pandan leaves, then stir until fragrant. | Transfer the rice to a rice cooker and cook with chicken stock until fluffy. | Slice the chicken and serve it over the fragrant rice with cucumber, light soy sauce, and chili lime sauce.

title: Laksa
description: Spicy coconut curry noodle soup with prawns and fish cake.
ingredients: rice noodles, prawns, fish cake, tofu puffs, bean sprouts, coconut milk, laksa paste, dried shrimp, chicken stock, laksa leaves
steps: Soak or blanch the rice noodles until just tender and set them aside. | Fry laksa paste with a spoon of oil until aromatic, then add dried shrimp and stir to release flavor. | Pour in chicken stock and bring to a simmer, then add coconut milk and tofu puffs. | Add prawns and sliced fish cake and cook briefly until the prawns turn pink. | Place noodles and bean sprouts in bowls, ladle the hot laksa broth over, and garnish with laksa leaves.

title: Char Kway Teow
description: Wok-fried flat rice noodles with egg, Chinese sausage, and bean sprouts.
ingredients: flat rice noodles, egg, Chinese sausage, fish cake, bean sprouts, garlic, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, chili, chives
steps: Heat a well seasoned wok until smoking and add a little oil. | Fry minced garlic briefly, then add the noodles and toss quickly over high heat. | Push noodles aside, scramble an egg in the wok, then mix through. | Add sliced Chinese sausage, fish cake, and bean sprouts, and toss until heated through. | Season with light and dark soy sauce and a little chili, then finish with chives.

title: Nasi Lemak
description: Coconut rice served with sambal, fried anchovies, peanuts, egg, and cucumber.
ingredients: jasmine rice, coconut milk, pandan leaves, anchovies, peanuts, egg, cucumber, sambal
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear and drain well. | Cook the rice with coconut milk, water, salt, and pandan leaves until tender and fragrant. | Fry the anchovies until crisp and toast the peanuts until aromatic. | Serve the coconut rice with sambal, fried anchovies, peanuts, sliced cucumber, and a fried or boiled egg.

title: Satay
description: Skewered marinated meat grilled and served with peanut sauce.
ingredients: chicken, beef, lemongrass, turmeric, coriander powder, cumin, brown sugar, soy sauce, peanut butter, coconut milk
steps: Cut the meat into small cubes and marinate with lemongrass, turmeric, coriander, cumin, sugar, and soy sauce for at least two hours. | Thread the meat onto skewers and grill over medium high heat, basting with remaining marinade. | Simmer peanut butter with coconut milk, chili, and a splash of soy sauce to make a quick peanut sauce. | Serve the satay hot with peanut sauce and sliced cucumber and onion.

title: Roti Prata
description: Flaky pan-fried flatbread served with curry or sugar.
ingredients: plain flour, salt, sugar, water, ghee, oil
steps: Combine flour, salt, sugar, water, and a bit of ghee to make a soft dough. | Knead until smooth, then rest the dough balls in oil for at least two hours. | Stretch each ball into a thin sheet, fold into a coil, and flatten. | Fry on a hot griddle with ghee until golden and flaky on both sides. | Serve with curry or a sprinkle of sugar.

title: Mee Goreng
description: Spicy fried yellow noodles with egg, tofu, and vegetables.
ingredients: yellow noodles, egg, tofu, cabbage, tomato, garlic, sweet soy sauce, chili paste, lime
steps: Heat oil in a wok and fry garlic until fragrant, then add chili paste. | Add tofu and vegetables and stir fry briefly. | Add noodles and toss with sweet soy sauce, then push aside and scramble an egg. | Toss everything together and serve with lime.

title: Chilli Crab
description: Crab in a sweet, savory, and spicy tomato–chili sauce.
ingredients: mud crab, garlic, ginger, shallots, tomato sauce, chili paste, egg, cornstarch, spring onion
steps: Clean and portion the crab, then pat dry. | Stir fry garlic, ginger, and shallots until fragrant, then add chili paste and tomato sauce. | Add crab pieces and a splash of water, cover, and simmer until the shells turn bright red. | Thicken the sauce with a cornstarch slurry and swirl in a beaten egg to finish. | Garnish with spring onion and serve with mantou.

title: Bak Kut Teh

steps: Blanch pork ribs briefly to remove impurities, then rinse. | Simmer ribs with smashed garlic, white peppercorns, and water for 1.5 to 2 hours until tender. | Season with soy sauces to taste and serve hot with rice and fried dough sticks.

title: Hokkien Mee
